context: The player has encountered Lae'zel trapped in a cage with two tieflings, Damays and Nymessa, arguing over what to do; Damays had urged taking the githyanki back to camp while Nymessa wanted to leave her alone. Lae'zel is dangerous and mistrusted — Shadowheart may have warned the party — and nearby events (the creche, Vlaakith’s agents) have already raised tensions. In this scene Nymessa is killed during the Lae'zel recruitment encounter, and Damays’ line ("Nymessa — no!") is a shocked, grief-stricken reaction to that death. Depending on player choices the fight can escalate further (there is separate dialog if Lae'zel is later killed).
